title: Phone notifications (ntfy): start, 25/50/75%, pause with reason, end, errors; Resume/Cancel/timelapse from the phone (optional)

edits:
[gcode_macro M0]
gcode:
    PAUSE
[gcode_macro M0]
gcode:
    SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=_TWEAKED_NOTIFY VARIABLE=reason VALUE="'M0'"
    PAUSE
[gcode_macro M25]
rename_existing: M9925
gcode:
    PAUSE
[gcode_macro M25]
rename_existing: M9925
gcode:
    SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=_TWEAKED_NOTIFY VARIABLE=reason VALUE="'M25'"
    PAUSE

note: OPTIONAL (install with --with phone-notifications). Nothing is sent until the notifications are switched on (q2_notify.conf, ENABLED=1). The pause message is the most important one: it says why the print paused (AI spaghetti, AI foreign object, filament runout, M0/M25 in the G-code, manual) and has Resume/Cancel buttons and a camera picture. Pausing itself is unchanged: stock QIDI leaves bed and chamber heated and turns the nozzle off. A tick every 15 s only reads printer state; the messages go out through sh + curl with time limits, so a missing internet connection never delays Klipper or a print.
